title: Date + integer is a date: adding 1 adds a day

source.quote: Addition (+) INTEGER CURRENCY REAL Date/time INTEGER INTEGER CURRENCY REAL Date/time
source.supports: the Addition (+) table: any type added to Date/time gives Date/time

source.quote: the following expression returns the current date plus one day (exactly 24 hours)
source.supports: adding 1 to a date adds one day

derivation: Date/time + INTEGER is Date/time. One day after 2024-01-31 is 2024-02-01.
